settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Of a GitHub OAuth app. Empty = SIMULATED demonstration mode.

authMethod.name: GitHub
authMethod.description: Federated sign-in with a GitHub account (OAuth2 with PKCE + state; GitHub has no OIDC id_token). The account must be explicitly linked to a local account.

setupGuide.intro: Everything happens on this screen. Leave the Client ID empty to try the simulated demo mode (screen marked DEMO, fictional accounts).
steps: Open the {console} (Settings > Developer settings > OAuth Apps) > New OAuth App. See the {docs}.
As Authorization callback URL, paste exactly:
Copy the generated Client ID, generate a client secret, paste both into the fields below, then Save.
Each person then links their GitHub account from their Profile page (Linked sign-in providers). No automatic linking by e-mail.
